content.title: Goldman Helps Lead Financing for 5-Gigawatt Texas AI Power Sites
content.summary: The New York banking giant is working with real estate advisory Newmark Group Inc. to raise both equity and credit for the project building modular natural gas-fired generation serving a cluster of south Dallas data centers, according to developer GridFree AI.  The aim in this initial round is to raise “hundreds of millions of dollars” with more rounds as the first project is scaled up, according to Philip Krim, chief executive officer of Montauk Capital, which incubated GridFree AI.  Goldman declined to comment.
